# TheMHS Learning Network Inc.

> > TheMHS Learning Network Inc. is Australia and New Zealand's premier professional organization for mental health services, connecting practitioners through annual conferences, forums, webinars, and recognition awards.

TheMHS (The Mental Health Services Learning Network) serves as a central hub for mental health professionals across Australasia, fostering knowledge sharing, professional development, and excellence in mental health service delivery. The organization hosts major annual events and maintains a comprehensive awards program recognizing outstanding contributions to the field.

## Awards & Recognition

- [About the Awards](https://www.themhs.org/about-the-awards): Overview of Mental Health Service Awards recognition program
- [Exceptional Contribution Award](https://www.themhs.org/exceptional-contribution-award): Exceptional Contribution Award eligibility, criteria, and submission information
- [Tom Trauer Research Award](https://www.themhs.org/tom-trauer-research-award): Tom Trauer Research Award for mental health services research excellence
- [Lived Experience Change Maker Award](https://www.themhs.org/lived-experience-change-maker-award): Lived Experience Change Maker Award recognizing consumer and carer leadership
- [Service and Program Awards](https://www.themhs.org/service-and-program-award): Service and program excellence awards for mental health organizations
- [Media Awards](https://www.themhs.org/media-journalism-award): Media and journalism award categories for mental health storytelling
- [The Awards Selection Process](https://www.themhs.org/awards-selection-process): Awards selection criteria, judging process, and peer review procedures
